question_text: Describe the effect of using eight bits per pixel to encode colour in an image of a smooth sunset.
adaptation_rationale: Binary representation of images explicit; bit-depth reasoning relates available codes to shades. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: 8 bits provide256 possible codes; this limits available colours/shades, and rounding nearby original colours to the palette can produce visible banding/loss of gradient detail.

marking_points.criterion: Limited distinct shades relative to the original.
Explains banding, rounding or loss of a smooth gradient.
